correctness.rationale: Vertex classification is verified from active linear constraints. Separate affinity of signed volume reduces all contained tetrahedra to vertex quadruples. A standalone exact-int/rational computation regenerates the 24 formal vertices of each branch and exhaustively tests 63,756 Bernstein coefficient systems over the complete continuum of parameter values. Three explicit vertex quadruples give equality in the three regimes. Cube/octahedron cap subtraction derives the ambient volumes; factorized polynomial differences prove the unique normalized minimum at c=3/2, and derivative signs give the secondary minimum. No numeric sampling is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The family links four highly symmetric solids through a continuous, natural cubical/octahedral constraint. A complete exact function for all inscribed tetrahedra and all real parameters exposes sharp transitions and proves the unique global volume-fraction minimizer is the regular truncated octahedron, a structurally nontrivial selection among the family. The second strict local minimum proves the normalized efficiency is not a simple monotone truncation statistic. Explicit sharp witnesses and exact certificates make the continuum profile reproducible without claiming any general theorem outside this natural class.
